source.review_scope: Static source and direct algebra: separating the latest weighted-history term yields \(\alpha_{t+1}=e^{-r}\alpha_t+z_i^{t+1}z_j^{t+1}\), \(\beta_{t+1}=e^{-r}\beta_t+1\), matching \(S=\alpha/\sqrt\beta\). Odd negative-factor count equals cumulative-product sign. Maze tracing assumes one annotated continuation; an extra blue branch is outside that condition. The known clamp-gradient repair is already present. Earlier finite execution results are historical evidence, not new executions.
